title: JPocketEdition
description: Small Modpack that recreates old MCPE
body:
This mini modpack makes minecraft feel (a little bit) like old MCPE, like about 0.9.0 days.
You got:
- **Cyan Roses**
- **Greener Grass**
- **Classic Textures**
- **Main Menu Layout (_needs [FancyMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/fancymenu), may have issues._)**
- **Old buttons**
And that's pretty much it, enjoy! :)
